3.why: docs/content/modules/earthsea.md states POS outputs a pitch CV from 0V to 10V for the scale position of the note, and the grid reference section states it is in V/oct format

4.why: docs/content/modules/earthsea.md states EDGE produces an 8V gate when a note event is triggered

comment: The three knobs have no label printed on the panel; the jacks beside them are marked 1, 2 and 3 and the two lower jacks edge and pos. The maker names the knobs and their outputs SHAPE 1 to SHAPE 3 in the tooltips and CV 1 to CV 3 in the manual. Output index 3 is POS and index 4 is EDGE, which is not the order they appear in on the panel. The three knobs are described by one line because they are identical; the same holds for the three control outputs.
